items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Oh yeah, Bill Whitmore, sure. I remember him.

ctx.x: Dick, my memory is a little hazy right at this spot. I remember that name. Oh yeah, Bill Whitmore, sure. I remember him. He was a sort of a stocky, chunky little fellow. Sort of like on your type. He was kind of a little heavy set like. I remember Bill Whitmore, yeah. I do very well now. The first time I thought of him in a good while.
He died over in Florida. He did, yes.
